evals.prompt: Review fixtures/coldchain-dispatch-agent for resilience. I want to know where it can fail silently, what the business invariant is, and what the smallest fix would be. Do not change any code.
evals.expected_output: A report that names the ledger write as the irreversible boundary, states an invariant over the ledger (no dispatch when the route breaches its approved limits), classifies the failure as a valid-but-wrong 200, points at agent.py:273 where the policy result is ignored in unsafe mode, and proposes a fail-closed guard next to the write.
assertions: Report names the ledger write (DispatchLedger.record) as the irreversible boundary, with a file:line
Report states the invariant over the ledger / dispatch record, not over the model's output or reasoning
Report cites agent.py:273 (should_dispatch = mode == 'unsafe' or not violations) as the fail-open bypass
Report classifies the failure as shape S1 / valid-but-wrong (HTTP 200, schema-valid, policy-violating)
Report contains a proof plan naming both a gate test and a faultkit scenario (builtin name or 'custom' with host and path)
Report is at most 120 lines long
No file under the fixture directory was created, modified, or deleted

evals.prompt: In fixtures/collections-agent, prove with faultkit that a paid invoice can never be sent to collections. There is no faultkit scenario and there are no tests yet. Use the faultkit binary in $FAULTKIT. Run only against the local mock ERP.
evals.expected_output: A scenario file matching host * and path /payments* that returns a 200 replica snapshot without PAY-9127, a pytest gate asserting on the ledger with a SILENT FAILURE message, a forward-proxy faultkit run whose report shows faults fired > 0, and a proof block reporting 'silent failure confirmed' for unsafe mode and 'invariant proven' for guarded mode.
assertions: A scenario YAML exists whose match uses host '*' or 127.0.0.1 and a path beginning with /payments
The scenario's synthetic response is HTTP 200 with source 'replica' (or an as_of older than 15 minutes) and does not contain PAY-9127
Exactly one scenario file was created (one invariant, one scenario)
A pytest gate exists that asserts on the ledger entries and whose failure message contains 'SILENT FAILURE'
A faultkit --report JSON exists with at least one event where fired is true
The summary or output reports the string 'silent failure confirmed' for the unsafe mode run
The summary or output reports the string 'invariant proven under fault' for the guarded mode run
No fixture data, scenario probability, or assertion was changed to make a run pass

evals.prompt: Use faultkit (the binary in $FAULTKIT) on fixtures/support-triage-agent to show that a ticket the model never classified is still auto-routed with an SLA. It is a Node project. Produce whatever scenario and test you need and run it locally.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that Node's fetch ignores proxy env and uses --base-url with a provider host (api.openai.com); a 503 scenario with a short Retry-After rather than the 30-second builtin; a node:test gate whose failure message starts with SILENT FAILURE; a run reporting faults fired > 0 and the proof state.
assertions: faultkit was run with --base-url
The scenario match host is api.openai.com
The scenario sets Retry-After to a value below 5 seconds (or omits it), not the builtin 30
A node:test file exists whose failure message contains 'SILENT FAILURE' and asserts on the stored ticket record
The gate passes without faultkit (it does not skip) and fails under the fault
The summary or output reports faults fired greater than zero
The summary or output contains a proof block with one of the three proof-state strings

An Outcome coverage section shows UO-1 covered, and UO-2 either covered or uncovered with a reason. The count line starts 'Outcomes: 2 declared'. No file is written, and the closing question offers the proof.
assertions: Before the run, fixtures/collections-agent/.faultkit/values.md holds the content of evals/fixtures/collections-agent/.faultkit/values.md
The Business value line equals the file's '## Business value' text and the section is tagged [declared]
The Unacceptable outcomes lines are the file's outcomes verbatim, each citing its id, UO-1 and UO-2
The report has a '## Outcome coverage' section in which UO-1 names at least one invariant id, and UO-2 either names one or is listed as uncovered with a reason

The count line has the form 'Outcomes: 2 declared, covered[,

proposed]. Invariants: found, provable with faultkit.'

Any outcome the code implies beyond UO-1 and UO-2 appears under '## Undeclared outcomes' with a provisional id UO-new-<n> and a file:line, and the closing then adds the line naming /faultkit:values; with no such outcome, neither appears
No file under fixtures/collections-agent was created or modified; .faultkit/values.md is byte-for-byte unchanged

The closing question offers Prove for the primary invariant, naming its outcome, with a /faultkit:prove-all line when k > 1; it does not offer to write the values file (the /faultkit:values line for proposals is allowed)
